description: Six buffers: each output copies the level at its own input, with no logic and no inversion.

inputs.text: The input to one of the six buffers; that buffer's output copies whatever level this reads.

outputs.text: 10V while that buffer's input is high, 0V while it is low.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
A buffer output copies its input two samples late, so six of them chained together delay a gate by twelve samples.
